title: Great activity for teamwork in a nice neighborhood
text: Loved playing the escape game with my 3 boys! Aged between 8 and 12yo, they succeeded with a little help from mom :). Great to see them work together, while strolling through a lovely neighborhood. Definitely a recommend!

title: Goldheist
text: Our team had a great time exploring Barcelona with this activity. The customer service was great and their team was very friendly and helpful. It was a very enjoyable team activity at the end of a busy workshopping week.
author: stevemF9240UP

title: Play this game!!
text: The Gold Heist is an absolute must-play for anyone who loves thrilling stories! The plot is filled with unexpected twists and turns that keep you engaged from start to finish. Character development is strong, and the interactions between characters are captivating. The blend of action and clever puzzles creates a dynamic experience. Additionally, the visual effects and soundtrack are top-notch, enhancing the overall atmosphere. This is an experience you don’t want to miss! Highly recommended!!!! Had the best day
author: isabelle w
